text: ポケモン　２ひき　つれて　きてくれ

patterns.name: 〜てくれ
patterns.explanation: てくれ after a verb is a blunt, manly way of asking someone to do something for you. つれて　きてくれ = 'bring them along, will you'.

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: The て-form plus くる says you do something and come here. つれて　きて = 'take them with you and come'.
